questions.prompt: A plugin throws while its function runs. What state does its fiber end in?
options: pending, so it can try again later
disposed, because the error removed it
active, with the error stored beside it
failed, with the error kept on the fiber
questions.explanation: start catches the error, stores it in fiber.error and sets the state to failed, so a caller can see which plugin did not start and why.

questions.prompt: You dispose a fiber, then want the same plugin running again. What do you do?
options: Call start on the disposed fiber
Mount the plugin again, which creates a new fiber
Set the fiber's state back to pending
Nothing: a disposed fiber restarts by itself
questions.explanation: A disposed fiber never runs again. Mounting the plugin a second time makes a new fiber with its own child context.

questions.prompt: After await a.dispose() in the trace, what problem remains?
options: The llm service is still in the store, because nothing undid it
The fiber is stuck in unloading
The root context was disposed too
questions.explanation: dispose only changed the state. The plugin's provide call is not undone, so the old adapter stays in the store.
